newsitem.title: USA: CalEnergy completes funding for Indonesia project.
newsitem.headline: CalEnergy completes funding for Indonesia project.

text.p: CalEnergy Co Inc said Friday it completed project financing for the Dieng Unit 1 geothermal project located in Indonesia.

Dieng Unit 1 is a 55 net megawatt geothermal project which represents the first phase of a planned geothermal development project of about 1,000 MW under contract in Indonesia. Dieng Unit 1 is already under construction and, with the existence of successful production wells at the Dieng wellfield, is currently expected to begin commercial operation by late-1997.
CalEnergy said it intends to proceed developing Dieng on a modular basis with construction of up to three additional 55 MW units as the wellfield is further developed.
The construction loan of $120 million was arranged by Credit Suisse. The Overseas Private Investment Corp is providing insurance against political risks for CalEnergy's equity investment.
CalEnergy and its joint venture partner, Kiewit Energy Co, will each own a 47 percent equity interest in the project, and CalEnergy will operate and manage the project.
CalEnergy develops, owns and operates responsible power generation facilities.
